name: Exp_SR-RateIndicator
summary: This EA trades based on a Support/Resistance Rate indicator that identifies key S/R levels and measures the rate of price interaction with those levels. It enters positions when price breaks through or bounces off identified S/R zones with confirming momentum, aiming to capture trend continuation or reversal moves from these critical price levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于支撑/阻力比率指标进行交易，通过识别关键支撑阻力水平并衡量价格与这些水平的交互频率来产生信号。当价格突破或反弹至已识别的支撑阻力区域并有动量确认时入场，旨在捕获从这些关键价格位开始的趋势延续或反转走势。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于支撑阻力比率指标来识别价格关键区域，该指标通过统计价格触碰支撑阻力位的频率来评估其有效性。入场条件为价格突破重要阻力位时做多，或跌破重要支撑位时做空，同时需要动量指标确认趋势方向。出场条件包括到达止盈目标、触发止损或支撑阻力比率发生逆转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式，允许用户自定义风险参数。资金管理方面提供止损设置但具体倍数和比例依赖于参数配置，整体策略偏向趋势跟踪，在关键价位突破时入场跟随趋势运行。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is built on a Support/Resistance Rate indicator that identifies critical price zones by measuring the frequency of price interactions with S/R levels. Entry conditions trigger long positions when price breaks above significant resistance levels, or short positions when price breaks below significant support levels, both requiring momentum confirmation. Exit conditions include reaching take-profit targets, hitting stop-loss levels, or receiving a reversal signal from the S/R rate indicator itself. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing, with user-configurable risk parameters available. Money management incorporates stop-loss settings but the specific multiples and ratios depend on parameter configuration, making the overall approach trend-following in nature with entries at key level breakouts.

parameters.name: SR_RateThreshold
parameters.description: 支撑阻力比率阈值，超过此值视为有效S/R水平
parameters.description_en: S/R ratio threshold, above this = valid S/R level

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA订单

pros: 基于支撑阻力位的交易逻辑具有坚实的市场理论基础，关键价位的突破往往伴随较大行情
使用比率指标量化支撑阻力的有效性，比主观判断S/R水平更加客观和系统化
结合动量确认减少假突破入场，提高了交易信号的可靠性
pros_en: S/R based trading logic is grounded in solid market theory where key level breakouts often lead to significant moves
The rate indicator quantifies S/R level validity objectively, removing subjectivity from level identification
Momentum confirmation reduces false breakout entries, improving signal reliability
cons: 支撑阻力位的识别依赖于历史数据，在市场结构发生重大变化时可能失效
突破策略在震荡市中容易产生连续止损，缺乏有效的震荡行情过滤机制
止损和止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态调整，无法适应不同波动率环境
cons_en: S/R level identification relies on historical data and may fail when market structure undergoes significant shifts
Breakout strategies tend to produce consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets without an effective range filter
Fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit don't adapt to varying volatility environments unlike ATR-based alternatives
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
加入震荡/趋势市场识别过滤器，在震荡行情中减少突破交易或切换为均值回归策略
增加仓位管理的风险百分比模式，根据止损距离和账户余额自动计算最优手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Implement a ranging/trending market filter to reduce breakout trades in choppy conditions or switch to mean-reversion logic
Add risk-percentage position sizing that calculates optimal lot size based on stop-loss distance and account balance

risk_points: 固定点数止损在低波动率时可能过大而在高波动率时可能过小，风险控制不够灵活
缺乏最大回撤限制和每日亏损限制，极端行情下可能造成较大损失
突破入场在假突破频繁的市场环境中可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed pip stop-loss may be too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility, providing inflexible risk control
No maximum drawdown limit or daily loss limit, which could lead to significant losses during extreme market conditions
Breakout entries in markets with frequent false breakouts can result in consecutive losses
